sourcePolicy: Manually corroborated completed, individual corporate investments from original acquiror disclosures. First and second Labrador Gold tranches tracked separately; joint actors treated as one independent buyer group.

records.verifiedBy: Primary acquiror statement individually identifies buyer, shares, price, completed tranche and transaction date
records.notes: Joint-acting investor group: never treat the two names as two independent investors. Issuer-issued private placement, not an open-market purchase. Investment shares shown are incremental per tranche, not cumulative ownership.
records.type: Closed private placement — flow-through shares (first tranche)
